executiveAssessment.text:
Executive Conclusion. Renaissance New York Times Square Hotel's most important issue is concentrated competitive displacement by New York Marriott Marquis, not a vague visibility problem.

What the Data Is Telling Us. New York Marriott Marquis appears in 28 monitored scenarios where Renaissance New York Times Square Hotel is absent. That concentration matters more than a long competitor list because it identifies a repeatable substitution pattern. Related Reality Gap pressure includes Full-Service Hotel at 2.3% recognition, which may help explain why the hotel is not carried into those answers. Softest Scenario Capture is Family Travel at 0.0%. New York Marriott Marquis most often appears when the hotel is missing (28 scenarios).

Why It Matters. Leadership needs to understand why specific alternatives are surfaced instead of Renaissance New York Times Square Hotel in recurring demand contexts. Otherwise attention may stay on average scores while missing the concentrated leak. A displacement pattern that repeats is more actionable than a soft overall visibility narrative.

Where the Pattern Is Concentrated. Family Travel is the softest Scenario Capture at 0.0%. Focus where the gap is concentrated rather than treating every territory equally. New York Marriott Marquis appears most often when the hotel is missing (28 scenarios) — use that pattern for source and fact checks, not as proof of cause. Reality Coverage is 41.2% (7 of 17 attributes). Start with gaps that matter operationally — beginning with Pet-Friendly.

What Management Should Focus On Now. Focus first on the demand contexts where New York Marriott Marquis is consistently surfaced instead of Renaissance New York Times Square Hotel. Determine whether the relevant attributes and use cases are clearly represented across priority sources, and whether the hotel's own proposition is complete for those same contexts.

What Not to Overreact To. No comparable prior official period is available — read these as current levels, not period-over-period change.

What to Review Next. Open the underlying displacement evidence for New York Marriott Marquis and compare attributes cited in those answers with Renaissance New York Times Square Hotel's first-party and major travel-source representation. Confirm whether the same cues appear when the hotel is present.

biggestStrength.headline: Strong visibility for Leisure Travel
biggestStrength.body: For Leisure Travel searches, Renaissance New York Times Square Hotel appeared in 29.7% of AI answers, compared with 7.8% for the comparable hotels used in this analysis. That means the hotel was surfaced about 3.8 times as often as the comparable hotels used in this analysis. In practical terms, this is the area where the hotel is showing its clearest visibility advantage versus similar hotels.

biggestConstraint.headline: Not appearing consistently in AI answers
biggestConstraint.body: The hotel appeared in at least one AI answer for 45% of the traveler needs we tested, but across all individual AI answers it appeared 26.9% of the time. In practical terms, AI recognizes the hotel as relevant for many types of trips, but a traveler will not consistently see it among the hotel options surfaced.
